scope_reason: Every ported mob is an EntityCreature and its AI state is digest state.

members.name: updateEntityActionState
members.note: per old-AI mob: the enderman, pigman, blaze, spider (living.c calls spider_update_entity_action_state as EntityCreature's), silverfish and squid bodies each carry the flee-tick expiry, the target pick, the attack, the path follow with the 30-degree clamp and the strafe turn, the water jump roll; proven by fight-enderman-s1, fight-spider-s1, fight-pigmen-s1, fight-silverfish-s1 and fight-blaze-s42; its searches read this.worldObj (ai.c ai_creature_path_to_entity through nav_scratch_take_world), so a pigman that went through a portal searches the destination (pigman-away-s1, lane/dawnscenes)

members.name: updateWanderPath

members.name: getBlockPathWeight

notes: The per-mob updateEntityActionState bodies are indexed under each mob's file; this record cites the enderman's as the reference port. lane/idxentity: every open member verified against its port; the leash task pair is leash.c plus ai_add_leash_restriction. lane/reloadstate: updateEntityActionState's else branch (a dead entityToAttack is cleared) also takes a dead non-living entityToAttack (entity_to_attack_gone: the arrow of a shooterless hit) in hostiles_spider.c, hostiles_pigman.c, hostiles_silverfish.c and hostiles_blaze.c.
